Facts used:
- Harrowfield: population 90,212; water use 7,146 megalitres.
- Ossbridge: population 52,904; water use 3,862 megalitres.
- 1 megalitre = 1,000 cubic metres.
- 2025 tariff = 142.35 tenge per cubic metre.

Calculations:
- Harrowfield cost per resident = 7,146 × 1,000 × 142.35 ÷ 90,212 = 11,278.58 tenge.
- Ossbridge cost per resident = 3,862 × 1,000 × 142.35 ÷ 52,904 = 10,388.76 tenge.
- Difference = 11,278.58 − 10,388.76 = 889.82, rounded to 890 tenge.

ANSWER: Harrowfield | 890
